features.name: Composite TUI redesign
acceptance_tests: Overview screen shows collapsible sections and supports group/filter toggles
Tactical screen combines map and spawn list on one screen
Inspect screen combines player, target, hex dump, and spawn list
features.notes: Started on feat/composite-tui from master. Replacing the 6-screen model with Overview, Tactical, and Inspect while preserving existing renderers where practical.
